evidence: Modifies orphan transaction handling in src/node/txorphanage.cpp and txdownloadman_impl.cpp to fix peer memory exhaustion.
rationale: Peers can exploit orphan memory accounting to bypass caps by a factor of 28, enabling severe remote memory exhaustion. The PR description notes that a single standard-weight orphan with 199,000 1-byte witness elements consumes ~11.1MB instead of its accounted limit, and a peer holding ~40MB of such orphans can force ~700MB of heap allocation and 0.9s of CPU time.
